description: Estudiantes del CBTA 42 de VillaCorzo, Chiapas. Técnicos en Ofimática
summary: My team and I developed an Astro Health website that monitors astronauts' health and uses AI to help them self-regulate. The challenge arises when an astronaut experiences a health issue, or when the AI, for example, asks if their helmet has broken outside the spacecraft, provides an immediate solution. This is very important because it makes it easier for astronauts to monitor their health off Earth.
details: Our project ensures that when an astronaut experiences a health problem, our website can help them know what to do and how to self-regulate and monitor their condition. It offers an AI that can ask questions about what to do in case of an emergency and provides an immediate response, allowing the astronaut to access medical services off-world for greater safety. We utilize software programming and the Lovable application.
dataRefs: The effect of space on the human body
